## Overview

A **jump process** is a continuous time [[markov-chains|Markov chain]], i.e. a
stochastic process in continuous time with a countable state space $S$. It
sits in the continuous-time, countable-state corner of the classification in
[[markov-process]].

## Contents

Read the chapters in this order.

1. [[markov-property]]: the memoryless property.
2. [[jump-process-fundamentals]]: construction from jump times and holding
   times.
3. [[jump-process-stability-regularity]]: when the process does not explode.
4. [[jump-process-generator-backwards-equations]]: transition semigroup,
   generator and Kolmogorov backward equations (see also
   [[kolmogorov-equations]] and [[infinitesimal-generator]]).
